fusions.name: Ink Pellet
fusions.desc: Spits a pellet of ink that deals 12 shadow damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Hindered] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: Lashes out in 8 quick strikes at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Slipped Moorings
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, with 10% more dodge chance while you do.

fusions.name: Cloud and Away
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, a ward of ink wraps you that absorbs 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
